root_cause: Repository hygiene only understood title-based generated candidate families, so explicit same-obligation successor PRs could coexist with their predecessors and multiply CI/WIP even though canonical lineage already identified the successor.
prevention_rule: Before generic candidate-family cleanup, close an older open PR only when a newer open PR has the exact same non-empty Obligation-ID and explicitly declares Supersedes: <older PR number>. Never infer supersession from similarity. When a predecessor is closed, cancel its queued/in-progress/waiting/requested/pending GitHub Actions runs within a bounded per-run cancellation budget so obsolete heads stop consuming runner capacity.
